Getting help with flexyBayes

Source: SUPPORT.md

Where to ask

Question Where
How do I do X with flexyBayes? GitHub Issues
I think this is a bug. Bug report, with a reprex
I would like a new feature, engine or model structure. Feature request
A security problem See SECURITY.md. Please do not open a public issue.
Bayesian mixed models in general Stan Forums or the INLA discussion group, which are larger and more active than this project.

Maintenance

flexyBayes is maintained by a small team within Analytics for the Australian Grains Industry (AAGI). This file is in the GitHub repository and on the documentation site, not in the package tarball.

Item Current value
Primary maintainer Max Moldovan, Adelaide University (email in DESCRIPTION)
Number of maintainers Not yet set
Weekly maintenance hours Not yet set
Issue response time None committed for 0.18.0
Security response time Acknowledgement within 7 days (see SECURITY.md)
If the package is no longer maintained Not yet set. The default is handover to AAGI.

A good reproducible example

Please include:

  1. A small data.frame that can be copied and pasted.
  2. The exact flexybayes() call.
  3. The full output of sessionInfo(), including the INLA, brms and Stan versions.
  4. The error or unexpected output, copied as printed.

For a problem during fitting, run with verbose = TRUE and include the generated model code it prints: the Stan program for backend = "brms", or the INLA formula for backend = "inla".

What we cannot help with

  • General R questions. See Stack Overflow [r].
  • ASReml-R syntax outside the subset flexyBayes implements. See VSNi support.
  • Tuning INLA beyond the settings flexyBayes exposes. See r-inla.org.
  • Installing a Stan toolchain for the brms engine. See mc-stan.org and the rstan getting-started guide.
